input_sample: Thrillers involving serial killers are usually my favorites, but this movie was God awful. I watched it on the strength of the description and Robert Downey, Jr being one of my favorite actors. It is a convoluted mess and not nearly as clever as it tries to be. Only watch if you need a sleep aid.

Based on the above textual attributes as indicators, please assess whether they can contribute to a comprehensive understanding of sentiment. If they can help reveal sentiments, emotions, expressions or attitudes, brainstorm ideas and generate corresponding prompts.

Requirements:

1. Provide a direct, point-by-point response for each prompt.
2. Each prompt should analyze a different aspect of the text. Aim for diversity in the prompts, ensuring they explore a variety of dimensions.
3. The format of the prompts should be universal, meaning they can be applied to a wide range of texts without relying on specific names, products, or context.
